Specification of Execution Management
AUTOSAR AP R23-11
7.4 Process Lifecycle Management
7.4.1 Execution State
Execution States
characterizes the internal lifecycle of a
process
. In other words, they
describe it from the point of view of a
process
that is executed. The states visible to
the
process
are defined by the
ara::exec::ExecutionState
enumeration, see
[SWS_EM_02000].
